issues.description: Method name mismatch for the song entry point: the Problem Statement instructs students to implement a method named printFarmSong() (problem_statement.md), but both the Template repository (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) and the Solution repository (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) define a public method named singFarmSong() and a private helper singFarmSongVerse(Animal). This inconsistency can confuse students about which method they are expected to implement or call (they may implement printFarmSong() while the provided code and tests expect singFarmSong(), or vice versa).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Option A (preferred): Update the problem statement to ask for singFarmSong() as the public entry point (and optionally mention the private helper singFarmSongVerse(Animal)) so instructions match the template and solution. Option B: Rename the method in the template and solution from singFarmSong() to printFarmSong() (and update all call sites and the helper name/references, e.g., Main.java and singFarmSongVerse) so the code matches the problem statement. Document the chosen name in the UML/requirements so students are unambiguous about the expected API.
